faqs.question: What is the 0 to 60 mph time of the Ford Explorer ST?
faqs.answer: The Ford Explorer ST accelerates from 0 to 60 mph in approximately 5.3 seconds. This impressive speed is achieved thanks to its twin-turbocharged V6 engine and standard all-wheel drive.

faqs.question: How much horsepower does the Ford Explorer ST have?
faqs.answer: The vehicle produces 400 horsepower and 415 lb-ft of torque from its 3.0-liter EcoBoost engine. This power allows for strong towing capabilities and rapid highway passing.

faqs.question: How does the Explorer ST compare to the Dodge Durango RT?
faqs.answer: The Explorer ST is faster and handles better than the V8-powered Durango RT. However, the Durango offers a traditional V8 exhaust note and slightly higher maximum towing capacities.

faqs.question: What is the seating capacity of the Explorer ST?
faqs.answer: The Explorer ST typically seats six passengers using a three-row layout with second-row captain's chairs. An optional second-row bench can increase the total seating capacity to seven.

faqs.question: What are the most popular performance upgrades for this SUV?
faqs.answer: Owners frequently install aftermarket engine tunes, cold air intakes, and custom exhaust systems. These simple modifications can easily boost the engine output well beyond the stock 400 horsepower.

faqs.question: What is the top speed of the Ford Explorer ST?
faqs.answer: The Ford Explorer ST has an electronically limited top speed of 143 mph. This high-speed capability is supported by performance brakes and a sport-tuned suspension system.

content_html:
What is the Ford Explorer ST?

The Ford Explorer ST is a high-performance midsize SUV developed by Ford Performance, featuring a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter EcoBoost V6 engine. It blends three-row family utility with track-inspired driving dynamics, delivering sports-car acceleration and aggressive styling that sets it apart from standard family haulers.

This performance-oriented SUV has redefined what buyers expect from a practical three-row family vehicle. It bridges the gap between daily school runs and spirited weekend drives on twisty back roads.

As buyers look back at the successful 2023 Ford Explorer lineup, the ST trim remains the undisputed crown jewel of the family. It offers a distinct personality that contrasts sharply with more traditional utility vehicles on the market.

Engine Performance, Horsepower, and Speed Specs

Under the hood lies a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter EcoBoost V6 engine tuned by the Ford Performance team. This powerplant delivers impressive numbers that rival many dedicated sports sedans on the market today.

The official ford explorer st horsepower and torque ratings stand at 400 horsepower and 415 lb-ft of torque. This power is routed through a quick-shifting 10-speed automatic transmission to all four wheels.

When it comes to straight-line acceleration, the ford explorer st 0 to 60 time is a blistering 5.3 seconds. This rapid sprint makes it one of the quickest three-row SUVs in its price class.

For those interested in track capabilities, the ford explorer st top speed specs top out at an electronically limited 143 mph. This velocity is supported by a sport-tuned suspension that keeps the heavy chassis remarkably flat through corners.

Interior Comfort and Seating Layout

The cabin balances high-performance styling with the everyday utility families require. Drivers are greeted by sporty front bucket seats featuring micro-perforated leather inserts and silver accent stitching.

The ford explorer st interior features and seating configuration accommodates up to six passengers with standard second-row captain's chairs. A third-row bench allows for extra passengers or folds flat to maximize rear cargo volume.

Tech enthusiasts will appreciate the large vertical touchscreen interface and the fully digital instrument cluster. Sound isolation is excellent, keeping the cabin quiet until you step on the gas pedal.

Ford Explorer ST vs Dodge Durango RT

A common comparison in the performance SUV segment is the ford explorer st vs dodge durango rt. While both vehicles target the same enthusiast demographic, they achieve their speed through very different engineering philosophies.

The Durango RT relies on a traditional naturally aspirated 5.7-liter Hemi V8 engine. This setup produces a classic muscle car rumble but falls short of the Ford in outright horsepower.

The Explorer ST utilizes modern turbocharging to deliver superior fuel economy and quicker acceleration. It also handles corners with more agility due to its lighter platform and modern chassis tuning.

Popular Performance Upgrades

Enthusiasts looking to extract even more speed from their vehicles have a wide variety of aftermarket options. The aftermarket community has embraced this platform with enthusiasm since its initial release.

Common ford explorer st performance upgrades include cold air intakes, custom engine tunes, and upgraded exhaust systems. These modifications can easily push the twin-turbo V6 past the 450-horsepower mark with minimal effort.

Upgraded sway bars and lowering springs are also popular for improving cornering stability. High-performance brake pads are highly recommended for drivers who plan to test their vehicles on track days.

The Broader Ford Utility Family

The Explorer ST is part of a larger, highly successful family of Ford utility vehicles. Buyers often cross-shop this model with smaller options like the versatile 2023 Ford Maverick pickup truck.

For off-road enthusiasts, the rugged ford bronco 2021 model year kicked off a modern 4x4 revolution. This was followed by the highly capable 2023 ford bronco, which offered incredible open-air trail riding experiences.

Looking forward, the upcoming ford bronco 2025 lineup promises even more advanced trail-riding technology. Meanwhile, the compact 2025 ford bronco sport offers everyday efficiency with a healthy dose of outdoor styling.

What is the 0 to 60 mph time of the Ford Explorer ST?

The Ford Explorer ST accelerates from 0 to 60 mph in approximately 5.3 seconds. This impressive speed is achieved thanks to its twin-turbocharged V6 engine and standard all-wheel drive.

The vehicle produces 400 horsepower and 415 lb-ft of torque from its 3.0-liter EcoBoost engine. This power allows for strong towing capabilities and rapid highway passing.

What is the seating capacity of the Explorer ST?

The Explorer ST typically seats six passengers using a three-row layout with second-row captain's chairs. An optional second-row bench can increase the total seating capacity to seven.

What are the most popular performance upgrades for this SUV?

Owners frequently install aftermarket engine tunes, cold air intakes, and custom exhaust systems. These simple modifications can easily boost the engine output well beyond the stock 400 horsepower.

What is the top speed of the Ford Explorer ST?

The Ford Explorer ST has an electronically limited top speed of 143 mph. This high-speed capability is supported by performance brakes and a sport-tuned suspension system.
